stage: Prospective paired ablation; implementation ready does not mean accuracy validated. Collection deployment and calendar registration remain separate explicit steps.
target: Reuse event_census and precision_frontier exactly: hourly anchor before next close +5% and next24h high +15%,720h history,24h event refractory; alerts1..6h before anchors; outcomes mature30h later. Unknown outcomes are null,never negative.
universe: Keep original114 non-BTC symbols frozen in universe.json for prospective comparison. Current3-symbol capture is infrastructure-only and cannot justify a whole-market claim. Register UTC calendar start before collecting study data; do not choose coins based on future results. Report both paired coverage and all114-coin event recall,including events lost to missing books.
timing: Hourly candle-close observations; use only book samples received at or before each observation. Offline closed candle context assumes finalized candles available at boundary; report this latency approximation, no real-time execution claim. Never backfill missing historical books with current snapshots.
micro_features: At each hour aggregate1,5,15,60min windows: medians of ask_depletion_buy=max(-ask_depth_change,0)*max(net_taker_fraction,0),bid_recovery_sell=bid_recovery*max(-net_taker_fraction,0),ask_cost_depletion_buy=max(-ask_cost_change,0)*max(net_taker_fraction,0),mid_return_60s,spread_bps,andfraction of valid rows without trades. Null netflow becomes0 only when there are zero ordinary buy+sell trades. Require>=95% distinct1sec buckets with ready status and finite inputs in every window, latest valid observation<=2.5sec old, no receive gap>2.5sec, same run+connection+generation; otherwise no micro score. Overlapping capture intervals for a symbol rejected. No summing overlapping60sec flow windows.
comparison: Same hourly base candidate gate as precision_frontier, same covered rows and labels for both models. Baseline context3 and context3+24 microfeatures,StandardScaler then logistic C=1,max_iter2000,no resampling,tuning or feature selection. Also show base candidates lost to missing micro coverage. No scores trained on test.
registration: Register start and fixed universe before collecting evaluation outcomes.28days train,48h embargo,14days calibration,48h embargo,56days evaluation. Train/cal labels must fully mature before next boundary; never shift periods after seeing results. Short captures remain infrastructure-only, outside primary registered study.
selection: Both models threshold at calibration score80th percentile, fixed before evaluation. Same-coin24h cooldown,first chronological eligible score crossing,no daily quota. Primary comparison requires evaluation alert counts ratio0.8..1.25,otherwise report unmatched budget and do not claim incremental benefit.
support: Do not fit without>=20 distinct positive target events and>=1000 mature candidates in training,>=10 distinct target events and>=200 candidates in calibration,both classes in each. These are predeclared feasibility gates,not a theorem of sufficient power. Final80% evidence gate preserves>=100 alerts,>=10% all-event recall,>=8 active weeks,precision and both exact and7day block95% lower bounds>=80%.
evaluation: Wait until entire evaluation+30h is observed; save model parameters and thresholds before evaluation starts. Report precision,all/reachable event recall,alert frequency,lead,missing/unscorable observations andpaired calendar-week bootstrap precision difference. Benefit requires lower bound>0,comparable alert counts,>=100 alerts and>=8 active weeks in each model; no threshold selection on test. Sparse coverage may fail support; report insufficient data rather than silently extend or relax.
operations: No trades or notifications. No scheduler or service installed by this protocol. Public historical spot klines may be fetched to label captured intervals; unfinished candles excluded. Original studies and model locks remain unchanged.
